currentUser.authentication: Login bearer token or Login access cookie backed by a current, unrevoked session
currentUser.subjectBinding: subjectId is derived only from the validated Login access-token sub claim; no caller-supplied subject is accepted

privileged.authentication: per-relying-party bearer service token and x-cedros-relying-party header
privileged.tenantBoundary: orgId must be in the relying-party policy and the subject must have a current membership in that organization; absent and cross-tenant subjects share the same 404

freshness.source: synchronous Login-owned user and membership records
freshness.consumerRule: do not persist or reuse the projection after a request or session boundary

ledgerTransactionProof.boundary: requires a dedicated nonce-bound Solana transaction-proof contract; it is not inferred from solanaWalletLinked

botVerification.boundary: a transient, purpose-bound verification verdict must be consumed during the Login action; it is not profile state or generic user metadata
